newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks end weaker but off lows.
newsitem.headline: French stocks end weaker but off lows.

text.p: French stocks finished slightly lower on Thursday as the bourse paused for breath after the previous day's strong gains.

Bonds were flat, and disappointment with half-year results at some companies weighed on the bourse's blue chip CAC-40 index, which closed down 5.75 points, or 0.27 percent, at 2,136.09. The CAC-40 futures contract fell 13 points to 2,136.
Electrical equipment supplier Schneider fell 3.13 percent to 238.30 francs after reporting a first-half profit of 503 million francs which was on the low end of market expectations.
Eurotunnel shares were still suspended but should requote by next Tuesday, at the latest, said a source close to the Channel Tunnel operator's debt negotiations with its banks.
